description: Measured 2026-09-14 (scratchpad 8b_probe/recv_float.fz): 'send(self(), 2.5); receive do x when x > 1.5 -> :big; x -> {:small, x} end' prints :big on interp and fails on run and build with 'codegen: expected int receive value'. The receive matcher lowers a guard's ordering operators through emit_int_cmp_value with IntCC::SignedLessThan (src/compiler2/native_codegen/receive.rs, PatternGuardBinOp::Lt..GtEq), and receive_value_int refuses a Float receive value outright, so the matcher's '<' is an integer compare while the body's and the interpreter's '<' are the total term order. Same guard, three evaluators, two answers. Resolved by fz-21x.24, which deletes this evaluator; the recv_float program on three doors is its proof fixture. Closes with that commit.
title: A receive guard that orders a float fails to compile on run and build; interp answers it
